name: jev-chat-review
description: Monitor open Codex chats locally and optionally review completed turns with Jev.

interface.shortDescription: Local overview for open Codex chats, plus optional Jev review.
interface.longDescription: Open Codex chats can be monitored locally for current or completed turn duration and repeated identical tool actions/results. Jev does not guess model fit from prompt length, tool count, or repetition. This monitoring stores only derived signals and makes no AI/API calls. Optional Jev review after completed turns requires your AI Gateway key; chat data is sent to the provider and may incur charges.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show me my open Codex chats, turn durations, and repeated-action warnings.
